{{Quote|My little daughter's beloved bearded jax was killed by some sort of wild beast recently. The darling just won't be consoled until those horrible pests are disposed of. Do you think you could do this for me?|Parent of a grief-stricken daughter|<ref name="AED" />}}
The '''bearded jax''', or '''jax''' for short, was a small [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Diet/Legends|herbivorous]] [[Feline/Legends|felines]] found in the wilds of the [[Forest/Legends|forest]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] and [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] moon of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]]. One of their most distinguishing features was a [[Hair/Legends|beard]] protruding from the creature's chin. [[Beastmaster/Legends|Beast masters]] were able to domesticate the bearded jax as personal companions. [[Hologram/Legends|Holographic]] depictions of the bearded jax were also stored on [[Data cube/Legends|data cubes]], allowing them to be projected as [[holopet]]s. Their meat could also be cooked and consumed as [[Foodstuff/Legends|sustenance]]. The [[mammoth bearded jax]] was a [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] of jax notable for its considerably larger size. [[Bioengineering/Legends|Bioengineers]] were also capable of using the [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] of the bearded jax to incubate [[Mutant|mutated]] variants known as [[psychotic jax]].

==Biology and appearance==
{{Listen|filename=Cr-bearded-jax-vocalize.flac|title=Bearded jax vocalization|description=The distinctive purr of a bearded jax}}
The [[Diet/Legends|herbivorous]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Feline/Legends|felines]] known as the bearded jax was found in the wilds of the [[Forest/Legends|forest]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] and [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] moon of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]].<ref name="AED" /> However, determining which species were truly indigenous to Rori was a matter of debate.<ref name="Ruins">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Ruins of Dantooine]]''</ref> A group of jax was referred to as a pride. The [[Mammal/Legends|mammalian]] [[vertebrate]]s had a bristly [[Color/Legends|white]] hide while in the wild,<ref name="AED" /> but when domesticated, their hides could come in a variety of different hues, including shades of red, yellow and blue.<ref name="SWG:C6">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild</ref> Distinguishing features of the bearded jax included a prominent beard protruding from their chins, pointed [[Ear/Legends|ears]], and a long tail with a tuft of [[Hair/Legends|hair]] at the end. The [[Limb/Legends|quadrupedal]] creatures also had small, [[Cat/Legends|cat-like]] paws and yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. When vocalizing, they would emit a trill purring noise. When under attack, the bearded jax would bite and claw back to defend themselves. There were evidently a number of different breeds of bearded jax, such as the blooming jax, blushing jax, bounding jax, and pouncing jax, each of which resided on Endor. Another type referred to as fuzzy jax inhabited Rori. However, each of these breeds, or types of jax were virtually indistinguishable to one another in size, appearance, and behavior. On the other hand, there was a considerably larger [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] of the jax called the [[mammoth bearded jax]], also found on Rori. The bearded jax shared something of a physical resemblance to the [[kima]]s of [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], however kimas were [[Canine/Legends|canines]] rather than felines. To a similar degree, the feline species of [[kittle]]s were comparable to the bearded jax in terms of size and overall body shape.<ref name="AED" />

==History==
Bearded jax could be domesticated by [[Beastmaster/Legends|beast masters]] as personal companions or house pets. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]],<ref name="AED" /> a wild beast [[Death/Legends|killed]] a [[Gender/Legends|girl's]] beloved bearded jax, rendering her inconsolable. In order to alleviate her grief, one of her parents sought to hire a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to eliminate the pests responsible for killing the jax.<ref name="Console">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other}}Mission NPC: "Console Little Angel"</ref> An [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellia-based]] gang of criminals known as the [[Meatlumps]] also kept a bearded jax named [[Weezy]] in a cage, while a [[Farmer/Legends|rancher]] on Rori kept a number of domesticated jax in a fenced off enclosure.<ref name="AED" /> [[Hologram/Legends|Holographic]] depictions of the bearded jax were storable on [[Data cube/Legends|data cubes]], allowing them to be projected as [[holopet]]s in homes and other buildings across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Holopets">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=66920&resource=features|text=Holopets}}</ref> Using [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] from the bearded jax, [[Bioengineering/Legends|bioengineers]] were capable of incubating [[Mutant|mutated]] variants of the creature known as [[psychotic jax]]. These mutated jax exhibited a more intimidating appearance, including sharp, pointed [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]], longer claws, a spiked head, and a more vibrantly colored hide. Bearded jax could also be cooked and consumed as [[Foodstuff/Legends|sustenance]].<ref name="AED" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a [[Writing/Legends|written]] document titled ''[[Essential Cooking Skills]]'' detailed guidelines on how to best cook a bearded jax. In this document, a setting of 250 [[Temperature/Legends|degrees]] for a half [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] was the recommended criteria, depending on the calibration of the cooking instruments.<ref name="SWG:ECS">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=item|ESSENTIAL COOKING SKILLS}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Jax-animal.jpg|175px|thumb|A bearded jax holopet]]
[[W:c:swg:Bearded Jax|Bearded jax]] first appeared as [[W:c:swg:Creatures & enemies|creatures]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> In addition to the mammoth bearded jax, there also existed other named types of jax, including the blooming jax, blushing jax, bounding jax, and pouncing jax of [[W:c:swg:Endor|Endor]], and the fuzzy jax of [[W:c:swg:Rori|Rori]]. However, each of these jax were virtually identical in size and appearance to a typical bearded jax, so it is not clear to what extent they should be considered separate breeds, or if they were merely descriptive names for different types of the same creature.<ref name="AED" />

Early in the game's lifespan, dynamically spawned non-player characters offered a variety of simple [[W:c:swg:Quest|missions]].<ref name="AED" /> In one case, NPCs could offer a destroy mission titled "Console Little Angel," the storyline of which featured a bearded jax. The mission required the player to destroy creatures at an assigned [[W:c:swg:Waypoint|waypoint]] in exchange for a [[W:c:swg:Imperial Credit|credit]] reward.<ref name="Console" /> A [[W:c:swg:Mission Terminal|mission terminal]] quest titled "Daughter's Beloved Bearded Jax" offered a similar quest with the exact same storyline.<ref name="Daughter">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Daughter's Beloved Bearded Jax}}</ref> Elsewhere in the game, a [[W:c:swg:Data Storage Unit|Data Storage Unit]] document titled [[W:c:swg:Essential Cooking Skills|''Essential Cooking Skills'']] detailed recommended instructions on how to best cook a bearded jax.<ref name="SWG:ECS" />

With the release of [[W:c:swg:Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies'']], bearded jax could be [[W:c:swg:Tame (Ability)|tamed]] as [[W:c:swg:Pets|pets]] by players who pursued the [[W:c:swg:Creature Handler|creature handler]] [[W:c:swg:Professions (pre-NGE)|profession]].<ref name="AED" /> Following the release of [[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15 2005|Publish 25's]] [[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]] on [[November 15]], [[2005]], creature handlers were removed.<ref name="AED" /><ref name="NGE">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> However, with the release of [[W:c:swg:Chapter 6 Notes for May 22 2007|Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild]] on [[May 22]], [[2007]], [[W:c:swg:Beast Master|beast masters]] were added as an [[W:c:swg:Expertise|expertise]] path,<ref name="Chapter6">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=66959&resource=publish#chapter6|text=Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild}}</ref> allowing players to incubate creatures as pets.<ref name="AED" /> With the release of [[W:c:swg:Chapter 4|Chapter 4: "Armed and Ready for Action!"]] on [[November 30]], [[2004]], bearded jax [[W:c:swg:Holo-pet|holopets]] were made available to players as [[W:c:swg:Decorative art|decorative art]].<ref name="Holopets" /><ref name="Chapter4">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64186&resource=publish|text=Chapter Archive 2006}}</ref>
